# Reality Architect

> An open method, local system-gap assessment, and exportable architecture brief for building dependable AI workflows, and the practice of architecting a life around them: Imagine it. Build it. Witness it.

## The method: The Architect's Loop (five sequential moves)

- See — build an intelligence layer (a memory vault your agents read)
- Design — write a spec that separates thinking from doing
- Build — compose small, single-purpose agents and skills
- Automate — connect triggers, workers, human review gates, and receipts
- Compound — add a comparable outcome signal and review protocol

A person's gap is the FIRST move they haven't locked in; the moves depend on each other in order.

## The reality.md standard (v0.2)

An open standard authored here: a person-level memory file, the way CLAUDE.md is repo-level.
`~/reality.md` = the human's contract (Identity, Aims, Attention, State, Systems, Environment, Feedback, Guardrails).
`~/soul.md` = the inner contract (Purpose, Values, I am, The scene, Gifts, Vows, Voice, Gratitude).
`~/.reality/` (or `reality/` inside a notes vault, found through REALITY_HOME) = agent-maintained state: aims, daily
logs, the witness ledger (fact / meaning / action), evidence, approved snapshots, decisions, the twelve-domain atlas.
Agent protocol: READ, SURFACE, PROPOSE, LOG, GUARD, plus the Agent Charter (never certify causation, never blame,
propose rather than impose, consent before memory or sharing).
If your human has a reality.md and soul.md, read them before acting on their behalf. Spec:
https://github.com/frankxai/realityarchitect/tree/main/standard
Agent Charter: https://github.com/frankxai/realityarchitect/blob/main/standard/AGENT-CHARTER.md

## Principles

- Two registers, always labeled: meaning (imagination, the scene, what a sign means to the person) and mechanism (the
  studied pathway). No claim that thought, feeling, frequency or quantum effects change external events directly.
- Every recommendation should cash out in an inspectable artifact, an act, or an acceptance test.
- Agent plugin: /plugin marketplace add frankxai/realityarchitect
- Built on the Starlight Intelligence Protocol (SIP).

## Product proof

- The assessment runs locally in the browser.
- The result exports as a Markdown architecture brief.
- The open standard and starter templates live in the public repository.
